reviews.text: My minor stepson got in a little trouble last year, and we needed a lawyer fast. From a bench in the lobby of the police precinct I went on Avvo to look for the best defense lawyer, and Julie's name came up. I called the number (this was maybe 7 am) and got a text and call back from Katie Fernandez in less than 5 minutes. We explained what was going on, and she immediately called the precinct to let them know she was representing my stepson and to get more info on his arrest from them. Later that day she was able to get him released to us, and worked to build his defense case. She argued to get the case moved to family court, and ultimately all charges were dropped and his records sealed after a 3 month period with the only condition being that he didn't get into any more trouble. Julie and Katie were fully invested in the best possible outcome for my stepson, even checking in a few times afterwards to see how he was doing. We're so, so happy with the work they did, and can't recommend them enough.

I cannot begin to explain how frightened and scared I was when my husband called me to tell me he had been detained by the police at JFK airport. Not realizing the law in New York and accidentally having taken his firearm with him from Florida on a boat he sailed to NYC for training, TSA stopped him when he put his bag through screening to fly home. He had no intention of hiding anything or breaking the law but the port authority police handcuffed him and took him into custody for what was an honest mistake. Fast forward, my family found Jeremy. He was calm and reassuring during one of the most difficult times in our lives. He explained what he thought would happen and how he would get past the felony charge without serving jail time. He even was able to maintain my husband's clean record, clean! Jeremy never promised a result but he did promise he would work hard.  Though he was busy at times he answered all of our questions (sometimes we would tag team with questions) and calmed our nerves. Most importantly, in the end Jeremy delivered just like he said he would.

The lesson that is most important is don't forget to take any weapons out of your bag when travelling through the airport (especially in New York!) The penalties are real!!! The second lesson is if you do, consider Jeremy. My family and I are glad that we did!

reviews.text:
If you are reading this, you have found the right attorney! I was in the most distressed time of my life. I did not know where to start. My brother hired one of the best criminal attorneys in Memphis,TN. I called him and explained my situation and I asked if he knew or had colleagues in San Diego,CA. He said, no but I would advise you go on the Avvo website to start. Also, he said; you do not want a lawyer that has been doing this too long or right out of law school. I thanked him and he said good luck! I then, went to the Avvo website and after scrolling through. I read Peter Blaire’s background, yrs of experience, and the statement “  Our primary goal is to fight aggressively on your behalf to ensure you move beyond your case towards a successful future and a clean record” grabbed my attention. I knew the uphill battle I was facing.  I called Peter Blaire immediately and gave a summary of my situation.  Peter Blaire spoke with confidence, directness, and assertiveness. No sugar coating. I knew I found the right man for the job and he is not what I call “ a glory getter”! I expressed to Mr. Blaire from the beginning; I have integrity and will be transparent with my situation.  After almost 1.5yrs with patience and resilience my false allegations of a misdemeanor and felony charges were dismissed! I took 2 DV classes and parenting. These classes are effective for victims and offenders. I also had to have someone monitor me with my son for 6 months on the family side to prove the truth! I could breathe again.  Peter Blaire’s commitment and demeanor helped remind myself I was fighting for myself and 4yr old son. It fueled my determination and motivation to prove the truth of false allegations. Furthermore, I had to hire a family attorney. Despite what I have endured and continue in this process. Always trust your gut! A long story short. I was young and naive when I married a charismatic high ranking naval man who who claimed to be a victim and portrayed me as the offender.  I was trapped in a situation across the US away from my family. My case was not clear cut and was unique.  I hope this review helps someone in a similar situation. Peter Blaire is your wingman, his job is to defend and protect by having your back! Don’t give up!

David Goggins once said; “Living a life avoiding failure does only one thing for you: it never gives you the opportunity to see what you truly are capable of”.

reviews.text:
Chris Perri is - in my opinion - the most talented habeas attorney in Texas.  While I recommend you hire Chris before your family or friend needs a habeas attorney - Chris Perri is who to go to if that person had an incompetent trial attorney or if new evidence has come to light.  For me as a Republican to think so highly of a former Democratic congressional candidate should say something.  Competence trumps politics.

It goes beyond saying looking for a habeas attorney is not the same as getting a traffic ticket attorney.  I recommend any family member or friend to review Mr. Perri’s briefs in the Texas appellate courts.

Win loss records are tough to glean in Texas since almost all won cases are expunged.  However, there is one really cool statistic that is true as of the date of my review.

For writs of habeas corpus (do a partial search of WR and then Perri at the CCA website), Chris has 6 pending cases out of a total of 18.  Most of the other habeas attorneys with notable Google presences as in the range of 1 or 2 pending cases out of like 50 total cases.

Find me an attorney in Texas with a better publicly available writ percentage.  I don’t think you can.  Furthermore, that percentage cannot include the won cases because of expungement law.

Furthermore, I urge you to go in and look at even the cases Chris has lost.  We’re talking writs of habeas corpus here - not getting a lawyer to sign you up for defensive driving.  Every single case that is challenged by local officials has an objection.  Furthermore, almost every single case has gotten at least an independent review by the CCA.  This does not happen with most lawyers much less those who go pro se.

Chris has a vetting process which is easier on the budget and fair.  Finances aside, this protects your loved one from having a poorly written writ actually filed and you then have no more realistic bites at the apple for your family member or friend.

I have paid Chris for a charitable writ of habeas corpus case that is still pending (it is for the 1 client of Chris Perri’s that is not in TDC) at a discounted rate.

(In the anticipation of potential ultimate victory and expungement, I am not posting the case name in this review.  However, even if the final outcome is adverse, I know Chris put up the best fight of any attorney and I know his client has and will have all of Mr. Perri’s briefs to deal with any potential future background issues while the case is pending or if God forbid there is an adverse outcome in a system designed not to allow writs to be considered easily.)

reviews.text: Musca Law is an outstanding Criminal Defense team, and I do mean team. I was unaware that you could not take pictures of any vessels while in the port and did not have any knowledge of this vessel being under port surveillance, but this did not matter to the arresting officers. I tried to explain to them that I was just a tourist, and was just trying to get some pictures of these huge cargo ships and Navel ships to share with friends and offered to delete any pictures that I had already taken but to no avail, these officers were convinced that I was involved with arms dealing. Knowing that I lived out of town they even insured that I would not have to be present for the several court sessions that proceeded that actual trial date. Prior to that they first got my charges reduced to a Misdemeanor charge which I was very satisfied with but the Lawyers at Musca law were not satisfied with that because I would still have something on my record, when I went to court on November 20 2019, I expected to be charged with a Misdemeanor of Trespass but to my astonishment I walked out of the court room with no charges on my record at all. For a vet who prides the right to bare arms an having a clean record is a must if you want to own a weapon. Musca Law is one hell of a law firm and like I said I had an entire team of Lawyers working my case when I hired Musca Law and they made sure that my rights were protected so if your like me and find yourself in serious trouble just being in the wrong place at the wrong time and want a great Law firm for a very reasonable price Call Musca Law, they really listen to you and will fight for all your rights.

Mr. Mutimer was a great attorney and exceeded my expectations.  This was a second offense DUI and I was fully prepared to have to take a guilty plea.  After talking with Christopher he reassured me that if we requested a trial we could get a better deal than a suspended jail term.

Up until the day of my hearing I was unsure due to the fact that the state said they would enhance my changes if I requested a trial.  The morning of Christopher invited me to the office to watch my body cam footage with him so he could once again reassure me.  After this meeting I decided to put it all in Christopher’s hands and we requested a trial.

Two months before my trial, the prosecutors office decided to accept a deferred sentence and I entered the deferred sentencing process.  One year later my case was dismissed and I didn’t even have to return to DC or stand in front of a judge.

From the beginning it was obvious that Christopher was well known within the court house and as a result I felt so much more comfortable.  From having my hearing first on the docket to negotiating with the prosecutors with a simple in person conversation or email.

I highly recommend Christopher to everyone, especially those who wish to maintain a clean record.

I was referred to Ahmad & Nolan Defense firm for my criminal case through word of mouth, which attests to their stellar character and reputation. When I first met Aneeq, his experience and calm demeanor really encouraged and helped me feel that I could trust him, which is crucial when it comes to attorney-client relationships.
I have wanted to become a doctor for years, and I was facing a very serious felony that held a very high maximum sentence of prison time as well as permanently ruining my dreams of attending medical school. I shared my goals of becoming a doctor with Aneeq, and he assured me he would do everything in his power to make sure this was possible.
Initially there was one serious felony charge, and the person pressing charges had purposefully falsified police reports, making it a very difficult case to fight. Aneeq worked very hard and spent hundreds of hours, bringing on multiple experts and private investigators to expose the lies this person had told, in order to defend me. Aneeq’s connections were very important in the success of my case, and having the extensive network and resources on hand speaks to Aneeq’s professionalism and skill.
Early on Aneeq noticed a crucial detail in my case that many other attorneys would have missed, and this led to many different facts of the case being discovered that really helped me. Additionally, recognizing this detail led to a witness coming forward and testifying on my behalf. Aneeq filed multiple motions throughout the case, many of them being pages long, and this gave us the opportunity to continue fighting the case. These motions that he filed were extremely meticulous and technical. Aneeq is one of the most detail-oriented people I have ever met, and he wrote these motions with precision and accuracy., giving us the best chance of success
Aneeq advised me not to take the plea’s that the prosecution offered, and advised me when to take the plea. His risk-assessment and analysis of a case's strengths and weaknesses is phenomenal, and this allowed me to secure an amazing result in this case. Aneeq and his team got the prosecutor to admit this case was a probation case, not a prison case, and to lower this serious felony to the lowest possible felony available. In sentencing, they got me ZERO jail time and expungement of all charges. This result will allow me to continue on my path towards medical school. I could not be happier with the results, and more impressed with Aneeq Ahmad, Michael Fuentes, another lawyer at his firm, and the rest of Aneeq’s team. I will recommend Aneeq to anyone I know who needs an attorney's services. Thank you all!!!

I made the mistake of drinking and driving in early 2019. Shortly thereafter, I found myself tangled up in the law searching for a competent legal team to represent me in what little did I know at the time would be a grueling, painful process, and in many ways it still is as i reflect back to a year ago when I was initially arrested.

Because the process is so painful its all the more important that you selectively choose a good lawyer. I found Saad law with no recommendation or much research, and fortunately for me my acorns landed at the root of a solid legal team that is personal and treats you like a human being.

I can truly say that with the assistance I have received from working with Steven and Caroline that I was not just a dollar to them. I have worked with them for a year now and have been with me every step of the way.  They are an open book, and at all times, whether its emails or phone calls or you just need someone to vent to about things, they are always their to make sure your questions are answered and your stress is put at bay.

Everyone is looking for the best possible results when it comes to matters of the law. My DWI was not expunged because plain and simple I was guilty as charged BUT, they were there to make sure that I was given a lesser sentence so that it did not destroy my life going forward. They knew my dreams and ambitions as an adult college student piecing his life back together after this unfortunate event and they kept that at the forefront of their strategy to ensure that whatever I faced didn't destroy the future I had in store for me.

They get to know you, they care about who you are and what you wish to do with your life and they do everything they can in their power to ensure whether your guilty or not that the conviction your facing is not going to limit the potential you have in store for yourself.

Not every case is won by erasing a DWI, but they can also be won in cases like mine where I was able to get a reduced sentence so that my future was not delayed in anyway. I owe my future to them and I could not feel more blessed or thank God enough that I accidentally found a great legal team to represent me.

Thank you very much!

Bryan

reviews.text:
Jesse Scharff (and the Scharff Law Firm) is amazing beyond belief!
To summarize – here are reasons you should hire Jesse Scharff without delay:
1.  Jesse and Reba communicate well. This also goes for all the personnel in his office. Jesse and the Scharff Law firm do their best to answer your questions within 24 hours and they keep you informed through the whole process.
2. Jesse will not bullshit or sugarcoat you. He will be straightforward and let you know his thoughts and opinions about your case.
3. Jesse knows the Judges, the DA’s and all the people important in your case. He has the ability to spot weaknesses in the prosecution and the officers.
a. He will give you information to review – so you can review if you would like. In my case, I reviewed everything. I researched a ton and none of that mattered, because Jesse had it handled.
b. Jesse will also give you the standard information for you to do prior to your court case.
c.	Do what he says.  I finished all the classes, pre-work and community service before my first court case in preparation for the worst scenario.

Here are my reasons and why I say the above:

I hired Jesse for a DWI charge.  He was a recommendation from a friend, whom in her case had a different attorney she fired, in order to hire Jesse.  The Sunday morning after my arrest on Saturday, I called Jesse’s number, about an hour later, he called me and we spoke for about an hour.  In this initial conversation, I was impressed; not only by what he had to say, but also because of his demeanor and the steps he took to outline what I should do next.  Every time I met with Jesse, he was organized and on track.

Here is where Jesse’s experience and patience seals the deal.  When the DA was arguing my case, she went after everything, my demeanor, and my character and she presented a few incorrect facts and made broad and unclear assumptions.  Jesse leaned over to me and said, “All she is proving is that you were intoxicated” and that’s what she did.  After about an hour and thirty minutes, the DA only proved that I was intoxicated and could did not prove that I was driving or that I was complicit in any illegal activity.  Jesse got up and spoke for about three minutes to refute the evidence and said “Your Honor, we have no evidence my client was in the car, and much less driving.”

My case was dismissed and all charges dropped. My arrest and record were expunged and I have my life back.

The Scharff Law Firm is exactly what it is supposed to be. It’s not super fancy, glamorous or in a pretentious high rise building.   It’s perfect for an honest, hardworking firm. Jesse speaks to you as his friend & ally - always showing up to court to walk you through the process.

Jesse and the Scharff Law firm charge a fair and honest fee and the charge is worth every single penny!  Jesse sits down with you each time to give you instructions and his game plan.  Follow all of his (and his firms’) instructions.

I refer everyone to Jesse and would not hesitate to use him again.  I could not have asked for a better person to advocate on my behalf.  I trust Jesse and the Scharff law firm and I thank them for all their efforts.

This is officially the first review I've delivered any service provider.  After the experience I've had working with Ryan and Elizabeth, it would be wrong of me not to take the time to compose this review.  The work these folks do is second to none. Were there more stars available for this review, I would be sure to deliver each and every one of them....and without hesitation.  They are  well deserved.

Some background:  one of my family members is a police officer.  When I found myself in a troubling situation with the law, I immediately went to her asking for advice on an attorney.  Ryan and Elizabeth were recommended not only by her, but too, by a number of people on the Force.  As it turns out, it was for good reason.

Going into my case, my sister explained that the nature of my charges were going to make this a difficult case to 'win'.  In fact, it was hard.  Ryan and Elizabeth were there every step of the way.  And they were responsive every hour of the day.  And, in an industry ripe with 'frauds', they proved to be the real deal - true technicians.

Ryan was up front with me when we first met that this case wasn't going to be an easy one.  After a grueling and stressful number of months, Ryan and Elizabeth were able to get my case dismissed.  They were creative in their approach; and they didn't ever stop.

Recently, I wanted to get the case expunged.  Doing so should not have proven to be difficult given the 'continuance for dismissal' ruling I was delivered.  Turns out, it was hard indeed.  Due to the nature of my charges, we met some resistance within the system.  After an initial declination of our request, we revisited it.  And for what it's worth, taking a second stab at this wasn't ever a debate.  Elizabeth just jumped back in upon receiving the declination.  Just yesterday, I received a notification that the expungement request had been officially granted.  The records are sealed.  Ryan and Elizabeth beat the odds.  They lived up to the hype.

Again - there are not enough stars available to adequately frame up my satisfaction and appreciation with these two individuals.  If you're in need, you're in need - go meet with them.

Only my second time to have the need of an attorney. I was issued a citation because my car license number was recorded by someone who alleged my offense. Really weird deal, the offense was that I through trash into a dumpster that was owned by an apartment complex. This citation was a Class C misdemeanor but showed my offense as "Theft of Services". I have a squeaky clean record and this is type of word "Theft" on anyone's record could ruin any future possibilities of employment.
My initial contact was at the Arlington TX. office located on Cooper St. I was greeted by 2 hispanic ladies. I explained the situation to Mory. She was very patient as I tried to explain the whole thing and how important it was for me to fight this citation. Mory took a look at my citation and made several calls for me. She initially quoted me a price of $100 to handle the representation for this citation. She could tell that was more than I was hoping to pay. I was amazed as she made another phone call and advised me the cost would be $45. Mory was very observant to notice that I had reached the last day to notify the court of my plea. If I had gone past that day, there may have been a warrant issued for my arrest. Mory typed out some legal papers for me and I ran down to the municipal court, that day,  and had the not guilty plea filed verifying my attorney as Justin Holt. My whole experience with the Arlington office was excellent.
I received a call from the attorneys office approximately 2 weeks later following up on the citation. It was important to me to totally understand how the representation would be handled and if there would be any additional costs should I go to trial. Eventually, I found myself speaking with Justin Holt my attorney. Justin was excellent and patient explaining to me in layman's terms how he would handle the case and verifying that there would be no additional costs. Justin advised me that I would be notified within a few weeks about a possible trial date. Shortly thereafter, I received a letter that explained the upcoming events and called the office to verify. The office was very patient and explained clearly my appearance and where to meet at the municipal court. I met Justin Holt at the municipal court. Justin represented me with the judge. I was notified approximately 1 week later that the case or citation had been dismissed. The total cost for my attorney's service was $45. Can't say enough good things about this experience.
Just to verify, I do not know Justin Holt personally or anyone else associated with his firm. Just a satisfied customer that wanted to take the time to give kudos for a job well done..

********I'm updating my review as I was requested to complete the review at the beginning of the case. Unfortunately my view in this law firm has completely changed.

I don’t typically leave many reviews, but some time has passed to really delve into the positive effects that have occurred since Attorney Cate Purdum took on my case, that in the moments of waiting and getting done what was required, can easily be overlooked when the now mentality becomes the forerunner of the experience when such services are needed.

Without going too much into sensitive information, I will try to share a little about the help I received in regards to an incident that required myself to be separated from my family for about three months. During this time, the services of Patituce & Associates were acquired; Cate drove out to meet with me to help ease any discomfort and kept mostly in contact with me when necessary, though, I would have much preferred more updates or a general hello to remind me I wasn’t forgotten, but this was likely a situational feeling due to the separation.

The judge we had was extremely strict and wanted certain requirements to be completed now, but due to time restraints and the order of which things could be done and when they could be done, we had to be patient and file for motions of continuance.

As this was happening, Cate, and at one point, one of her colleagues, would meet with the prosecutor and myself at each court date with necessary evidence, updates, and advocacy and go before the judge; the charge against me would have been a felony and time served. Though the case was not dismissed, the charge was dropped to a minor misdemeanor with the ability to expunge the verdict from my record after six months, something I plan to do in the future, and no probation.

I’m very grateful for the work put into my case, and for the length, as it gave everyone time to do what they needed and gave me time to receive the therapy I wasn’t ever really able to undergo to heal and learn from childhood trauma and the likes. I’m happy to text, that due to this work we all put in, I have now established two jobs without any issue and I am able to confidently and courageously volunteer within my community and be a growing mother and companion to my family.

You have my sincerest thanks, Patituce & Associates.

With much respect,
J. Bright

James was very honest and transparent with me about the potential hurdles, but assured me he was up for the challenge. He was very well educated about expungement law, and was citing sources that might be applicable to our case. He guided me step-by-step through the entire process letting me know what to expect and how to mentally prepare. He was fantastic during our court appearance. He had clear knowledge of all of the nuances of my case and was able to articulate them accurately to the judge and the opposing attorney.

This was a very emotional process for me, as I have a lot of shame surrounding the pour choices I made when I was younger - so much so that I have dedicated my professional career to helping individuals and families affected by addiction. And I was grateful that James always treated as a human being with compassion and respect. I never once felt judged for my mistakes.

I am thrilled to say that we got the outcome we had hoped for thanks to James' hard work. My record will officially be sealed, and I will be able to move forward and continue to help more people who struggle without being held back by my criminal record. When I found out the court found in my favor, I sobbed for almost an hour as I had believed this would be something that would haunt me for the rest of my life. To have this burden removed from my shoulders so that I can continue to be a positive contributor to society is a freedom I didn't expect to know. I am confident to say I won't need James' services in the future from criminal defense or expungement representation, but I would gladly recommend him to anyone looking to move forward from previous legal mistakes.

reviews.text:
In early 2022 my 21-year-old son was arrested and charged with 7 felonies and his bail was set at a million dollars.  His Public defender encouraged him to take a 1st degree sales charge right away.  I called around a handful of criminal defense attorneys that quoted me outrageous fees to retain their services and the tone in their voices seemed so grim.

Everything changed when I contacted Repka Law.  Dan called me back the same day.  He was so upbeat, positive, and ready to take on the task of getting the best possible outcome for my son.  It was 3 days before my son’s next hearing and Dan said immediately he wanted to be there to let it be known that my son would not be rolling over to a plea deal - and that he would fight for my son as if he were his own.  Needless to say, he got the job!

My son’s case took over a year in District Court–in that time Dan filed several motions to try and have his bail reduced and to ask for opportunities for him to go to treatment (he had everything lined up and ready if they agreed).  Each motion was denied, and we all were getting frustrated and feeling defeated, but Dan never gave up the good fight or lost hope.  Dan and I were in regular communication, and he called me before and after every hearing; to say I texted him a lot over the past few years would be an understatement :) He was always super responsive and supportive. He also had regular legal calls with my son throughout the entire process.

After Dan had looked over the evidence, or lack thereof, he concluded in his opinion that the search warrant lacked probable cause and the entire case should be dismissed.  The district court disagreed.  My son ended up not accepting any plea, was found guilty at a court trial on 1 charge of 2nd Degree Possession and sentenced to 48 months in prison.

Dan subsequently filed an appeal and argued my son’s case at the MN Court of Appeals like a RoCkStAr!! We lost a lot of battles along the way in District Court, but Dan ultimately won the war – and with a Precedential Published opinion at that! Justice prevailed!  My son’s entire conviction was reversed/vacated and he was able to walk out of Prison after 27 months of incarceration-  free from any type of supervision or parole and is now starting the process of getting his civil rights restored and the immediate expungement from his record.

My family will forever be grateful for Dan –  I cannot thank him enough for never giving up and for seeing this to the end. I consider him a dear friend and trusted confidant.  I honestly could not have made it through all of this without his kindness, support, wisdom, patience, empathy, and great sense of humor.   Dan knows the law; he has the endurance to keep fighting fearlessly for your rights and is not intimidated to face any legal battle. If you find yourself in a fight against any criminal charge Dan is who you want and need by your side!

His staff Mary and Andrea were also very respectful and supportive throughout this entire ordeal and deserve a shoutout as well!  Thank you all for everything!

reviews.text: Would recommend seeking other attorneys. The only time they were really attentive is the initial consultation when they are getting ready to ask for money as a retainer. I was 42 years old at the time with a clean record , a veteran, and had NEVER been in any trouble before. I was charged with Felony Assault.  Not only did I end up with the felony, but from day he never got an inch from the other attorney and kept telling me how it was the best we could do. I believe many other attorneys could have had the charge reduced and I likely would have ended up with a misdemeanor.  At one point I had to call and email my attorney no less than 6 times over a 2 week period with no response. I had to complain to another attorney at the firm to get a response. My attorney continued to tell me what he would do, but NEVER followed through without repeated requests or follow up on my part. Very non-responsive and maybe they just take too many clients at once. On top of that, he knew I was a veteran and didn't even tell me I could have been eligible to be tried or have my case go through the veterans courts. I likely would not have even had a felony. I made the mistake that got me in trouble, no doubt about that, but the other mistake I made was trusting this firm to represent me. Your money would be better spent elsewhere. Also, used the family division of this firm through a divorce. Had to fire them and hire a different firm which made the attention I was getting from Jason at WMDT look like a joke. I got farther and more answers from MI Family Law Center in a few days than this firm got me in 2 months. Thank goodness I switched! I plan to have my felony expunged when I can. I will not use this firm for that unless they offer to do it free for doing such a poor job TWICE.

Had a difficult case that should have been nothing, not an arrest certainly. The problem is once you are  arrested you really aren't innocent until proven guilty. Once your arrested good luck on your own, even if you are "barely" guilty. The problem is once convicted you have the same record as someone who beat their spouse and caused bodily harm, for tossing a computer AWAY from anyone. (Yes, not good but a crime?)

Susanne was able to walk me through the process and defend me. Yes, I paid fines and classes, but these were minimal in comparison to what others have experienced.

Jump forward 2 years. Surprise, surprise, I have a warrant for the above charges. The person that was supposed to close my case at AP&P quit, and my case did not get closed complete as it should have been. I called Susanne and she immediately took my case to the courts for dismissal, which it was. The courts were putting me off until the end of the month. I have a background check requirement for a new job. They aren't going to hire someone with an open warrant.

Susanne continues to impress me, worth the money. (She is not the cheapest, just the best.) We are going to work to have these charges expunge in June. I know Susanne will get it done. She know the laws, and she understands the Utah criminal system and courts inside and out.

reviews.text:
The day I met Ken Padowitz I handed him a preliminary report from a Audio Forensic Specialist that indicated abnormalities in the audio evidence the state had. I explained to Ken that I heard two different versions of this audio. I didn’t know the terminology then, but I told him exculpatory evidence had been removed.
Ken refused to speak to the forensic specialist, or allow him to do a final forensic report. Two years, and multiple requests both verbally and via email were ignored.
While constantly reminding me of the jeopardy I was in, and that a felony conviction with a one year probation was possible; he repeatedly tried to convince me that I was “mistaken” about the audio evidence.
I was forced to hire another attorney to get the audio analyzed and to hire a private investigator which Ken also refused to do.
I went ahead and hired the forensic expert that wrote the preliminary report I gave Ken. Ken disappeared. He didn’t attend a conference call to discuss the forensic report. Co council said he wasn’t returning calls. He didn’t return my calls or respond to my emails.
Fast forward, without Ken, a motion was filed and a judge threw out the recorded evidence after the same forensic expert that Ken ignored, demonstrated that 15 seconds of conversation were missing and portions of remaining conversations were now blank.
The judge then dismissed the felony charge. He then gave me a withheld of adjudication on the misdemeanor. No jail, no probation, and a sealed record.
If I did not hire additional attorneys to do Ken Padowitz job, there would have been no Forensic report, and I would have eventually been forced to accept a plea deal which would have resulted in a felony conviction.

I am writing this so that my experience with Tom can be known.  I was in a very difficult legal situation.  I was looking at my 4th D.U.I. This was a very difficult experience  for myself and loved one's .  I potentially was looking at serious jail time as well as my license possibly being revoked for life.  I am in my 40's, my life is very well put together, great job, place to live, great family and friends and my health. The possible consequences of my actions would have drastically changed my life and the lives around me.
My case was very difficult as this case involved myself being arrested for a  D.U.I in Rhode Island but my driver's license is from Florida. Not good to say the least. Again I was facing a 4th D.U.I. as I have 3 in the state of Florida.
Here is where Tom comes in.  Tom was recommended to me from a family/friend lawyer.  Tom came very highly regarded.  As a former state prosecutor he defiantly knows how the prosecutors act, think and his great reputation  is very obviously known in the courtroom .  Tom built a great client/lawyer relationship with me based on trust.  There were times in my case when I wasn't so sure if I had the best person representing myself, not only did I have the right person but I had the best lawyer. I had both, Tom the person and the lawyer.
My case as noted was extremely difficult, this wasn't the ordinary D.U.I, being it was my 4th and out of state. Tom worked within the legal system and was able to provide me with a hardship license to and from work.  I remember the D.A. in the courtroom denying me of this at first.  When Tom and I returned I in fact was granted this hardship license . I remember very well that I was told, "It's against my better judgement to grant you this, you should be thanking your lawyer for his competency ". I knew right then that I had the wisest person in the courtroom representing me.  Afterwards Tom met my family member outside of the courtroom , she was relieved with the ruling, he was very kind and genuine towards her.
Moving forward with Tom's expertise, effort and knowledge  I was able to drive to and from work.  I still had the D.U.I to contend with and if convicted , well off to jail I would go and life as I know it to be would have drastically  altered.
Tom once again found the police to have pulled me over without just cause. He and I were prepared to take this to court after my pretrial.  We had to wait for the state of Florida to collaborate with the state of Rhode Island. Tom was supportive, constantly working with me and my case during this time.  He always stayed in good communication, always did what he said he would do, and made me feel like there was a chance, there was reason to believe that my consequence's of my actions would be minimal .
In the end my D.U.I case was dropped by the state of Florida and Rhode Island.  I have community service and a alcohol class to attend . Meanwhile I am still able to drive to and from work.   Tom is also getting my charges expunged.  This is all very doable compared to the other very realistic possible set of circumstances that I could be in.
I write about my experience to share with other's . I write this because I want to thank Tom for all he accomplished for myself and family.  I think back to the times I had with all the unknowns in my life.  One thing I always knew was I had the right, best and trustworthy person by my side through this all. I obviously suggest that you don't make poor choices for yourself and don't have to deal with what I have.  If you are reading this you may have.  I strongly recommend , not suggest that you have Tom Thomasian as your lawyer. Tom, thank you!

reviews.text: If you find yourself in a situation where you need help, Tom is the person you want on your side. My boyfriend and I found ourselves in a situation where we needed a lawyer and were not sure where to start as neither of us have ever been in trouble. I remembered seeing an ad for AVVO so I decided to look on there. We knew it would be a somewhat easy case, but I am a worry wart so I didnt want to just pick some Joe Schmo. I sorted the website to see who had the highest AVVO rating and the highest reviews and that is how I found Tom Thomasian. I read all of the reviews and everyone seemed to be very pleased with his services and I saw that he offered a free consultation so I figured it wouldnt hurt to just meet with him and see what he thought. I called Tom's office and I expected to just set up an appointment with a secretary, I left my name and number and about 5 minutes later Tom called me himself to set up the appointment. I told him our situation and he seemed confident that he would be able to help us out. A few days later we met him at his office and after meeting with him and going over what he could do for us, I knew he was the right person to hire. Now don't get me wrong, he isnt the cheapest attorney, but you get what you pay for. Do you really want to cut coupons for a lawyer? I dont, I would rather pay good money and feel confident walking into court with someone who I know has our back. Tom was always there to answer any questions we had, whether I called him or sent him a text message. We went to court three times, each time we were there for 10 minutes max. In the end our case was dismissed and we had it expunged. Hopefully I will never have to hire Tom again, but I will always keep his card in my wallet because if anyone ever needs help he is the person I will send them to. If you are looking for a lawyer and you are scared and have no idea what to expect (like I was) he is the best lawyer to have because he will talk you through each step of the process and make sure that you are comfortable with what is going on with your case.

Much to my chagrin, after submitting payment for services, they pulled a bait and switch on me and assigned two rookies with less than two years of experience to represent me.  I knew after the first court appearance that this was not going to work, since the prosecutor was very aggressive.  A colleague at work and another lawyer highly recommended Mr. McCoppin to me because of his background as a prosecutor and his expertise with difficult cases.  I was convicted in district court, but we appealed.  Mr. McCoppin worked with the new prosecutors and successfully got my case dismissed, without having to go to trial.  My case was difficult because we couldn’t prove that the witness was not being truthful.  I couldn’t be happier with the outcome.  We are now working on getting my record expunged.  I highly recommend this attorney.  He knows what he is doing.

I never gave up hope and I prayed for a miracle. My prayers were answered when I found Attorney Steve Escovar on yelp.

Mr. Escovar and his team did something that no other attorney EVER did before. He really listened to me and RESEARCHED my case.
He knows the laws and was able to use new laws to my advantage.
He worked hard to get me the post conviction relief that I needed.

My hope was to, at best, get my charges reduced,
Instead Mr. Escovar got ALL charges DISMISSED!

I will never forget when the Judge said: “You now have a clean record “.

I am still in amazement at what Mr. Escovar was able to do.
And his pricing is more then reasonable.

Thank you Mr Escovar and Ms Mateus for getting me out of what seemed like an impossible situation.

reviews.text:
Kirby represented me on three different issues. The first being a 4 count felony case involving conspiracy. I was the co-defendant and the other defendant was facing a murder charge in a separate case that eventually was all intertwined into one case. The DA was tough, although I was completely unaware of the other defendants doings at that time and I was innocent of any wrongdoings, they charged me with different multiple serious felony counts of involvement because of my relationship with that defendant on a personal level. Kirby was able to get all the felony charges dismissed and reduced to a single misdemeanor disturbing the peace conviction with minimal plea terms, including only 1yr informal probation.

Once the informal probation was up, I then retained Kirby again to have that misdemeanor conviction expunged. Within weeks Kirby had that conviction and record expunged. Weeks later I retained Kirby again to expunge a DUI conviction I received over 10yrs ago. He first attempted to directly ask the DA, they refused to expunge that DUI. Those case expungements are on an individual case basis dismissed by a Judge. So once the DA refused Kirby immediately took my case to a judge and was able to get that DUI expungement for me as well.

I cannot say with words how grateful I am to Kirby and to his wife Kim. Not only did they fight for me every step of the way but they showed true compassion and made sure I was always aware of everything going on. He literally saved my life from charges that could have left me behind bars for a very long time. If you're looking for a criminal defense attorney in Riverside county, look no further. There is no one else you can entrust your case in more than Kirby.

reviews.text: This was my first time ever having to go through the expungement process, and I must say I am extremely pleased with the experience.  I saw alot of reviews on this company and alot of the complaints I saw were of people complaining of the documentation they had to provide. I feel you get what you put in and this company is here to help you as much as you let it. That being said, before I even called I had a copy of my disposition ready to go. I took the eligibility test, sent an email and got a response within hours. I personally talked to Mr. Huffman, got a list of things I needed to get ready and got to work.  Even living in Texas, the process went by smooth and quick.  Mr. Huffman required a few documents I already had ready prior and I was able to get letters of recommendation immediately.  Again, some of the complaints I saw were of people expecting this company to do ALL the work completely for them, which I thought was a bit absurd, especially living in these times we're in full of restrictions and delays. My start date was 03 DEC 2020 and I got my record Expunged with paper work in by 05 APR 2021. Not bad for being 3 states over and not once having to go back to California for any reason.  Mr. Huffman kept me updated with both emails and their tracking system online.  If you are going to go with this company, just remember, YOU are hiring them, and they are only as effective as you let them be. So have all your ducks in a row and be ready to help with some paperwork in order to receive the fastest response times available. Thank You Mr. Huffman for everything, I can now push forward with my career.

reviews.text: About two years ago I was charged and arrested for a DUI. I had no idea how to go about finding an expert lawyer that handles DUI cases or how to fight the case. I kept seeing  and hearing Larrys name and was interested but also hesitant. I thought since he was so good that he would have to many cases and wouldnt have enough time to give mine his full attention. I called his office on a Friday afternoon right before his office closed and got a hold of him. We set an appointment and he came in on a Saturday morning just to hear my situation and see what the next steps were. When I saw that he came in on a Saturday and had his full attention I knew he was the one. He started on the paper work to allow me to keep my license  until  my court hearing immediately. He also recommend that I do 40 hours of community service, and attend  a DUI and defensive driving course which I did. Two years have passed since then and a court date was finally set. Not only was i available to speak to Larry whenever but he always replayed or picked up his phone as well as his team. When ever I wrote an email or made a call there was always a replay with in 5 minutes. They kept me up to date with any changes or no changes in my case the whole two years i was waiting. I also had an immigration problem because i wasn't able to renew my work permit because of the pending case, he stayed in contact with my immigration lawyers the entire time keeping them up to date and also making sure what he wanted to do wouldn't affect my immigration problem in a negative way. When you hire Larry you dont just hire him you get his great team as well. Finally after 2 years of waiting I had a court date set for December 2016 and I was a nervous wreck, but he came through and was able to get my case dismissed. The entire case was tossed out, no jail time, no probation, no nothing! I highly recommend Larry if you or anyone you know is looking for a lawyer. He gave me the best Christmas present I could receive by getting the case tossed out and keeping a clean record!!
